what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12959 Eritrean refugees in Sweden, 2.3% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, reaching war level, and again in 2016.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003, with EIJM - AS as the opposition group in 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 40 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 27933, at the end of 2019, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
